Esc.does: Enter bootloader: board goes dark and waits for a flash. Only press after arming a flash; replug the cable to get out

effects.name: Solid
effects.desc: One colour everywhere. Fn+Left/Right hue, Fn+Up/Down brightness.

effects.name: Alphas / mods
effects.desc: Modifier keys in a second colour (base hue + speed), everything else in the base colour.

effects.name: Gradient (vertical)
effects.desc: A static hue gradient from top to bottom.

effects.name: Gradient (horizontal)
effects.desc: A static hue gradient from left to right.

effects.name: Breathing
effects.desc: The whole board fades in and out together.

effects.name: Band (saturation)
effects.desc: A band of colour sweeps across; saturation varies.

effects.name: Band (brightness)
effects.desc: A band of brightness sweeps across the board.

effects.name: Pinwheel band (sat)
effects.desc: A saturation band rotating around the centre.

effects.name: Pinwheel band (bright)
effects.desc: A brightness band rotating around the centre.

effects.name: Spiral band (sat)
effects.desc: A spiral of saturation turning around the centre.

effects.name: Spiral band (bright)
effects.desc: A spiral of brightness turning around the centre.

effects.name: Rainbow cycle
effects.desc: Every key the same hue, cycling through the rainbow.

effects.name: Rainbow sweep
effects.desc: A rainbow travels across the board, left to right.

effects.name: Rainbow fall
effects.desc: A rainbow travels from top to bottom.

effects.name: Rainbow ripple in
effects.desc: Rainbow rings contracting toward the centre.

effects.name: Rainbow ripple in (dual)
effects.desc: Rings contracting toward two centres, left and right.

effects.name: Chevron
effects.desc: A rainbow chevron sweeps across the board.

effects.name: Pinwheel
effects.desc: A rainbow rotating around the centre like a pinwheel.

effects.name: Spiral
effects.desc: A rainbow spiral turning around the centre.

effects.name: Dual beacon
effects.desc: Two rainbow beams rotating around the centre.

effects.name: Rainbow beacon
effects.desc: One thick rainbow beam rotating around the centre.

effects.name: Pinwheels
effects.desc: Two rainbow pinwheels, one each side.

effects.name: Flower blooming
effects.desc: Hues bloom outward from the centre like petals.

effects.name: Raindrops
effects.desc: Random keys change to random colours, slowly.

effects.name: Jellybeans
effects.desc: Random keys pop to saturated random colours.

effects.name: Hue breathe
effects.desc: Breathing where the colour shifts slightly each cycle.

effects.name: Hue pendulum
effects.desc: Hue swings back and forth across the board.

effects.name: Hue wave
effects.desc: A gentle wave of hue variation moving across the keys.

effects.name: Pixel fractal
effects.desc: A symmetric random pattern grows from the centre.

effects.name: Pixel flow
effects.desc: Random colours flow across the board like a conveyor.

effects.name: Pixel rain
effects.desc: Keys flash on and off at random like static.

effects.name: Typing heatmap
effects.desc: Keys you hit glow hotter and cool down over time.

effects.name: Digital rain
effects.desc: Green streaks fall down the board.

effects.name: Reactive
effects.desc: Dark until pressed; the pressed key lights and fades.

effects.name: Reactive hue
effects.desc: Pressed keys light with a shifted hue and fade.

effects.name: Reactive wide
effects.desc: A press lights the key and its neighbours.

effects.name: Reactive wide (multi)
effects.desc: Like Reactive wide, every press at once.

effects.name: Reactive cross
effects.desc: A press lights a cross through the key.

effects.name: Reactive cross (multi)
effects.desc: Crosses from every press at once.

effects.name: Reactive nexus
effects.desc: A press lights lines out to the board edges.

effects.name: Reactive nexus (multi)
effects.desc: Nexus lines from every press at once.

effects.name: Splash
effects.desc: A ring of colour spreads out from each press.

effects.name: Multi splash
effects.desc: Rings from every press, overlapping.

effects.name: Solid splash
effects.desc: A ring of the current colour from each press.

effects.name: Solid multi splash
effects.desc: Rings of the current colour from every press.

effects.name: Starlight
effects.desc: Keys twinkle like stars in the current colour.

effects.name: Starlight (dual hue)
effects.desc: Twinkling in two hues.

effects.name: Starlight (dual sat)
effects.desc: Twinkling in two saturations.

effects.name: River flow
effects.desc: Brightness flows along the key order like a river.

effects.name: Drift (custom)
effects.desc: Every key random-walks its own hue, nudged toward its neighbours; slow colour weather.

effects.name: Fireflies (custom)
effects.desc: Dark board; random keys fade in with a random colour and fade out.

known_issues: Bluetooth is off under QMK (the module protocol is not implemented yet); wired only.
